translations.web: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
translations.bsb: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
translations.kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
translations.asv: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath set over his household, to give them their food in due season?
